facts.fact: The Ministry of Digital Transformation officially launched the national internet exchange centre (IXP) at International Mauritanian Telecommunications (IMT) on 2025-05-28 (document gives no city or member count), with a technical presentation of its operation by the head of the Digital Infrastructure Foundation, per Sahara Medias reporting the ministry.
facts.system: Centre national d'échange Internet (national IXP at IMT)
